protocol.description:
Sub-protocol for configuring NVIDIA QuadroSync (framelock) hardware through the Display Config Server. This protocol is advertised as a wl_registry global only when QuadroSync hardware is detected.
Warning: This protocol is unstable and subject to change without notice.

interface.name: zwp_dcs_quadro_sync_manager
interface.description: Global entry point for QuadroSync configuration. Advertised in wl_registry only when QuadroSync hardware is present.

request.name: get_output

description.summary: extend a DCS output with QuadroSync state

request.description: Creates a QuadroSync output object extending the provided DCS output.

request.name: get_topology

description.summary: extend a DCS topology with QuadroSync settings

request.description: Creates a QuadroSync topology object extending the provided DCS topology.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the manager object. Objects created through it are not affected and remain valid.

interface.name: zwp_dcs_quadro_sync_output
interface.description: Extends zwp_dcs_output with QuadroSync state. Events are sent before zwp_dcs_output.done.

event.name: board

description.summary: QuadroSync board this display's GPU is attached to

event.description: Small integer identifying the board, stable for the lifetime of the server. Displays with the same id share one QuadroSync board. Not sent for a display whose GPU has no QuadroSync hardware.

request.name: get_configuration

description.summary: create QuadroSync configuration for this output

request.description: Creates a QuadroSync display configuration extending the base config.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys this object. The zwp_dcs_output it extends and any configuration objects created from it are not affected.

request.name: set_role

description.summary: set the QuadroSync role for this output

request.description: Set this output as framelock server, client, or disabled.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys this object and discards its pending role. The zwp_dcs_display_configuration it extends is not affected; a later commit of that configuration leaves the display's QuadroSync role unchanged.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys this object and discards its pending settings. The zwp_dcs_topology it extends is not affected; a later commit of that topology leaves the board-level QuadroSync settings unchanged.
